image_description: A close-up view of a wombat peering out from the entrance of a burrow. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse brownish-grey fur. Its head is broad with small eyes and rounded ears, and a large, dark nose is prominent. The burrow entrance is framed by rough, textured rock or earth. There is some red text overlay in the bottom right corner.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is stocky and heavy-set with a substantial, ground-hugging build.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal fills the burrow opening tightly, indicating a substantial girth and low profile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short powerful limbs with broad feet equipped with strong digging claws on forefeet.
